prompts.text: Close the measured 1-word gap: remove the redundant per-byte set_addr and RE-PROVE on silicon.

notes:
THE BIGGEST FINDING IS NOT THE BLOCK - IT IS A FALSE MODEL OF ROUTING, now INV-48 root cause C with a simkyt trace quoted: a word leaves on its SOURCE cell's face, but every cell it then arrives at forwards it on THAT CELL'S OWN face. The straight-line 'ray' model is FALSE. Under the ray model a 7x1 row checks out perfectly; on silicon the router's westward word hits the eastward-facing emit cell and bounces straight back. That produces a layout which places clean, builds clean, and hangs - the worst possible failure signature.

A FACT THE KB AUDIT MISSED: GolayDecoderBlock - the very block that refutes the cell cap - FAILS THE SAME TEMPLATE with a TypeError, because the RX shape writes Varicode-specific params (read_addr_hop/read_dest/read_entry) into blk.params. The template was broken for BOTH blocks, for neither reason the original quarantine gave. Verified: those writes are in panel_pnr.py.

IT APPLIED THE EVIDENCE RULE AGAINST ITSELF. It drafted a claim that FAN-OUT was the wall, then checked the shipped blocks first and killed its own draft: LMSEqualizerBlock ships fan-out 6 with 5 backward edges, FFT64Block 4 and 6 - both strictly WORSE than LZ4's (4, 3), both done. That is rule 2 of the new evidence rule working as intended.

THREE SILENT BUILD-PATH BUGS FOUND AND FIXED, each of which would corrupt any future block of this shape: (1) router._find_output_target returned the target's DEFAULT entry for a port carrying both a WRITE and a JUMP, so the emit cell's set_addr/write/lookup handoffs all fired the controller's FIRST entry; (2) router._fixup_write_instructions' sink fallback rewrote EVERY WRITE/JUMP in the exit cell to the port hop, aiming the panel protocol at x16_out - now honours RAW_OUTPUT_HOPS; (3) build._apply_output_port_routes lacked the guard its sibling _apply_routes has. A fourth (_patch_one_handoff matching by register number alone) is documented and worked around.

THE THREE VACUOUS WALL TESTS ARE DELETED. They used pytest.raises((PlacementError, TypeError, KeyError)) with no message assertion - the audit had shown the same shape passes for a WORKING 3-cell block. Replaced with gates pinning the EXACT unroutable edge set and the flip budget, both of which fail the day the gap closes, so the next agent is told rather than having to rediscover. The suite header records what each deleted gate got wrong.

Also fixed: the block declared no output_cell_id(), so the port map put its output on the CONTROLLER; and the false 'x1 is one bit wide' claim was removed from its docstring.

ORCHESTRATOR VERIFICATION: placekyt/tests/ 1219 passed with the engine changes (baseline-matching); 132 passed across LZ4 + Golay + Varicode + the SRAM panel suite; the RX template's Varicode param writes confirmed present; the corrected routing model confirmed to quote a real trace rather than an inference.

=== PASS 3 (2026-08-29/30) — the fix was RIGHT and is still one word short ===

THE set_addr REMOVAL IS CORRECT AND WAS PROVEN ON SILICON. My dispatch brief guessed the auto-increment might have different semantics at a MATCH boundary; that guess was WRONG and the builder measured why: the read and write paths do NOT share a counter. `write` drives wraddr, `lookup`/`read` drive rdaddr, and each re-writes the panel's single R5 address latch from its own counter before its own trigger. Verified byte-exact on a real chip + real SramPanelDevice across 6 sequences - literal runs, a match boundary, an overlapping match (offset=3 len=11), an offset==1 byte run, back-to-back matches, match->literal - with wpos == wraddr at the end. Frees exactly 3 words (emit 2 -> 5).

THE EARLIER 'IT BREAKS THE PANEL TESTS' WAS A HARNESS ARTIFACT, not a DSP defect: _panel_match_run presets wpos=8 mid-stream while wraddr boots at 0, so with set_addr gone the harness must seed both. Seeding wraddr alongside wpos makes the decisive gates pass unchanged. Pass 2 reverting rather than shipping was still the right call - it did not know this yet.

THE REMAINING GAP IS EXACTLY ONE WORD, and the search is now exhaustive over THREE windows, not one: cols 5-9 x rows 10-11 (24 feasible), cols 4-9 x rows 10-11 (20), cols 6-9 x rows 9-11 (20). In ALL 64 placements the emit cell must serve THREE directions (panel east, egress, gohead) = 6 words against the 5 it now has. Widening west does not help; adding a row does not help. Best cost is 9 flip-words total, egress invariably at (8,10) reached northward, emit invariably at (8,11) abutting the controller. No legitimate 1-word source exists: EAST's face code is numerically equal to the `one` constant but sharing them breaks orientation rotation (is_face words are rewritten by the placer), and zeroing `mat` by self-subtract trades a data word for an instruction, net zero.

UNTAKEN LEVER, and the obvious next move: SPLIT THE EMIT CELL IN TWO (INV-46's 'prefer more cells doing less'). That changes the block shape and needs its own silicon pass.

SEPARATE REAL TOOLCHAIN BUG FOUND - now INV-50: router._get_routing_distance walks each cell's own fwd_face (correct) but FALLS BACK TO MANHATTAN DISTANCE when the walk misses, silently returning a hop count for a path the word will never take. Wrong for 6 of 15 LZ4 internal edges (1.mat_seed->4: true 4, Manhattan 2). Fixing it made the FSM actually run. Eight call sites in router.py. LEFT OPEN: the naive fix regresses test_rotated_feedback_block_computes_identically because block-declared faces are stored UNROTATED while the placer rotates geometry, so a correct fix must rotate them per INV-23. The builder reverted rather than ship the half-fix.

TWO TEMPLATE RULES NOBODY HAD WRITTEN DOWN, both measured: the egress cell is NOT transparent (a blank on the emit cell's resting walk becomes the egress cell and is turned toward the output corridor, DEFLECTING the panel words - correct hops, zero panel writes), and the egress column is a FULL-HEIGHT WALL for horizontal walks.

IT ALSO STRENGTHENED ITS OWN CLAIM AFTER REPORTING: two further searches landed post-report and it volunteered the correction, in the direction of a STRONGER result (one window -> three). That is the behaviour the evidence rule is for.
